description: The only vault content write, same planSave path as the Save button. message required. Working-copy tools do not commit. consent_pending: Allow dialog is up; retry the same call after the user clicks Allow. pending_save: an offline plan is waiting; Save again when online. unsupported_vault_version: the vault marker is not the current format and no upgrade step is registered. conflict or repo-moved: a remote edit overlaps this Save; git_force_overwrite, or git_behind_resolve { action: "reload" | "branch", confirm: true }, or stop. Checked out on main: save_on_main and nothing is written; git_branch_create { name }, then git_save { message } on that branch. Results omit path fields. Over the wire a save is many GitHub round trips: when it is still running after about 20 s the call answers { status: "running", saveId } and the save keeps going; poll git_save_status { save_id } until it answers the save result (committed, clean, or the same errors). Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: git_save
